name: io.github.solresearchlabs/ultrasearch-mcp
title: UltraSearch MCP
description: Web research MCP server with search, fetch, crawl, provenance, and budget guardrails.

environmentVariables.name: ULTRASEARCH_SEARXNG_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional SearXNG base URL for local-first search.

environmentVariables.name: ULTRASEARCH_HOSTED_FALLBACK_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to allow hosted provider fallback.

environmentVariables.name: ULTRASEARCH_PROVIDER_ORDER
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated hosted provider order. Example: tinyfish,exa,parallel,brave.

environmentVariables.name: ULTRASEARCH_TINYFISH_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional TinyFish API key. Required only when TinyFish hosted fallback is used.

environmentVariables.name: ULTRASEARCH_EXA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Exa API key. Required only when Exa hosted fallback is used.

environmentVariables.name: ULTRASEARCH_PARALLEL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Parallel API key. Required only when Parallel hosted fallback is used.

environmentVariables.name: ULTRASEARCH_BRAVE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Brave Search API key. Required only when Brave hosted fallback is used.

environmentVariables.name: ULTRASEARCH_TINYFISH_LOCATION
environmentVariables.description: Optional two-letter TinyFish search location, such as US or CA.

environmentVariables.name: ULTRASEARCH_FIRECRAWL_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional Firecrawl API URL for crawl/fetch fallback.

environmentVariables.name: ULTRASEARCH_FIRECRAWL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Firecrawl API key. Required only when Firecrawl fallback is used.
